mapper.update: INSERT INTO classification (merge_key, code_value, code_name, japanese) VALUES (#{mergeKey}, #{codeValue}, #{codeName}, #{japanese}) ON CONFLICT (merge_key) DO UPDATE SET code_value = EXCLUDED.code_value, code_name = EXCLUDED.code_name, japanese = EXCLUDED.japanese WHERE ( classification.code_value, classification.code_name, classification.japanese ) IS DISTINCT FROM ( EXCLUDED.code_value, EXCLUDED.code_name, EXCLUDED.japanese )

INSERT INTO patent_classification ( patent_id, classification_id, inserted_at, updated_at, deleted, sync_id ) SELECT p.patent_id, c.classification_id, now(), now(), false, #{syncId}::uuid FROM patent p JOIN classification c ON c.merge_key = #{mergeKey} WHERE p.merge_key = #{patentMergeKey} ON CONFLICT (patent_id, classification_id) DO UPDATE SET deleted = false, updated_at = now(), sync_id = EXCLUDED.sync_id WHERE patent_classification.deleted IS DISTINCT FROM false OR patent_classification.sync_id IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.sync_id
UPDATE patent_classification pc SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() WHERE pc.deleted = false AND pc.patent_id = ( SELECT p.patent_id FROM patent p WHERE p.merge_key = #{patentMergeKey} )

UPDATE patent_classification pc SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() WHERE pc.deleted = false AND pc.patent_id = ( SELECT p.patent_id FROM patent p WHERE p.merge_key = #{patentMergeKey} ) AND pc.sync_id IS DISTINCT FROM #{syncId}::uuid
